t: Mempo | Military Wiki | Fandom
s: Mempo (also menpō, mengu[1][2][3] or occasionally men yoroi[4]), is the term for various types of facial armour worn by the samurai class and their retainers in feudal Japan. Types of Japanese facial armour include the somen, menpō, hanpo and happuri. Mempo were facial armours which covered all or part of the face and provided a way to secure the top-heavy kabuto (helmet).
